title: Oracle register programs in space S
statement: Let $L$ be a language of bit strings, let $A$ be a register program with $m$ registers and finitely many states, and let $\ell_0$ be its initial state. Suppose there are $d$ oracle languages $A_0,\ldots,A_{d-1}$, each decidable in logarithmic space, and functions $S:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ and a natural number $K$ such that $\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1\le S(n)$ for every $n$. Suppose also that, on each input $x$, the run from $\ell_0$ with all registers zero halts with the correct membership answer for $L$, and every configuration before halting satisfies the program's side conditions and has, for every register $r$, binary length of $r$'s value plus one at most $K S(|x|)$. Then $L$ belongs to the space class $\mathrm{SPACE}(S)$.
